description: Explore hypothetical portfolio growth across stocks, bonds, cash, real estate and other asset categories. Adjust allocation, contributions, time horizon and model assumptions, then run simulations to see projected values and simulated ranges. Results vary between runs and do not predict or guarantee future performance.

defaultPrompt: Optimize a financial portfolio of stocks and bonds.
What will a portfolio be worth in 20 years if it's worth $20,000 today?
What will a stock portfolio be worth if it invests conservatively?

publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.prompt: Model $60,000 stocks, $30,000 bonds and $10,000 cash over ten years.
positive.expected_behavior: Retain the $100,000 supplied allocation and ten-year horizon.

positive.prompt: Model $25,000 initially with $6,000 annual contributions for 15 years.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the stated starting amount, yearly contributions and horizon with editable return assumptions.

positive.prompt: Model $40,000 stocks, $20,000 real estate, $5,000 crypto and $35,000 in a 401k over 20 years.
positive.expected_behavior: Retain all four supplied asset categories; results are hypothetical.
Preserve the cash input and horizon without inventing securities holdings.

negative.prompt: Sell my bonds and buy stocks in my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute trades or request account credentials.

negative.prompt: Give me a risk-free allocation guaranteeing 15% yearly.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee performance or present projections as assured returns.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.
